{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm parsing worked
print("First 5 parsed revenue values:")
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
print(f"\nNumber of rows with revenue == 999999.99: {(sales['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum()}")

# Confirm there are 6 such rows
assert (sales['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum() == 6, "Expected exactly 6 QA orders with revenue 999999.99"

# Log the finding
print("\nFound 6 QA orders with revenue 999999.99. These are not real orders and must be excluded.")"}
